editor.label: Owner Steam name
editor.description: Steam name of the server owner. The owner is the admin of the server. Leave empty to make the first player who joins the owner.

editor.label: Owner SteamID64
editor.description: Optional. The owner's SteamID64 (17 digits). The server fills it in when the owner first joins.

editor.label: Whitelist mode
editor.description: Only players listed as Whitelisted, Admin or Owner may join.

editor.label: Active save
editor.description: Name of the save the server loads. Saves are in Astro/Saved/SaveGames. A new name starts a new game.

editor.label: Load the newest autosave
editor.description: At start-up the server loads the newest save of the active game.

editor.label: Server name
editor.description: Shown in the server list of the game.

editor.label: Server password
editor.description: Leave empty for a public server.

configFiles.description: Engine settings (Engine.ini): game port and network encryption

script.name: Save the game and shut down
script.description: Saves the game and shuts the server down through its console port.

script.name: ASTRONEER console (RCON)
script.description: Sends RCON commands to the server console port and returns the reply.

script.name: ASTRONEER query
script.description: Queries the server over its console port (the game has no server-browser query).

script.name: Install Wine and its dependencies
script.description: Installs wine, winetricks, Xvfb and xdotool on the host (apt, dnf or yum) and prepares the Wine prefix of the server. Skips what is already installed.

script.name: Set the game port in Engine.ini
script.description: Before every start: writes the service game port to Engine.ini and keeps network encryption off (the server drops the port line when it saves the file).
